_classification_scheme.ADOPT_AS_IS: Use the capability/tool/skill exactly as-is, no wrapping or modification needed.
_classification_scheme.ADAPT_BEHIND_HARNESSKIT_INTERFACE: Real capability worth using, but only via a HarnessKit-owned interface/gate wrapping it -- never raw/direct.
_classification_scheme.PROJECT_OVERLAY_ONLY: Scoped to a specific project overlay (e.g. an example project) -- not a general HarnessKit capability, must not be treated as one.
_classification_scheme.USE_AS_REFERENCE: Design patterns are worth learning from and reimplementing clean-room; the artifact itself is not adopted/installed/run.
_classification_scheme.DUPLICATE: This row duplicates another row's capability content -- the other row is canonical; this one is kept only for provenance.
_classification_scheme.QUARANTINE: Present/built but deliberately blocked pending a scan, decision, or policy gate -- not thrown away, just held.
_classification_scheme.REJECT: Explicitly rejected -- not installed, not adopted, not a future candidate absent a new explicit decision.
_classification_scheme.DEFER: A real decision (adopt/reject/adapt) has not yet been made -- postponed pending a named future gate or batch.

_fable_status: REJECTED — out of routing (no cheap-model tier; subagents fill it)
_mimo_status: external-reference-only (MIMO-0 source intel); NOT installable/runnable/connectable via this registry
_status_legend: verified | experimental | partial | deferred | absent | rejected | quarantined -- 'verified' is the only status this validator holds to its strict evidentiary bar (implementation path exists, cited self-test script actually passes on live re-run, real_run_evidence non-empty); all others only need schema completeness.
_selectable_rule: selectable:true ONLY for capabilities usable NOW (PRESENT + enabled, or a PARTIAL capability's verified read-safe subset). selectable:false for ABSENT | DISABLED | UNKNOWN | REJECTED | PLANNED, and for any network/secret/domain skill not explicitly enabled for routing. A selectable:false capability is NEVER a routable active-execution target; it may still carry fallback + risk metadata.

_write_gates._note: Mandatory close-out gates for every write batch (Tests + Security + Simplify). Maps to capabilities/agents available TODAY (compound-engineering ENABLED). Routing wiring is CE-1, not this batch.
